decision: Eligible for native admission after public readback; blind solve remains pending.
findings: Instruction describes the incorrect normalization behavior caused by the mutated singleton condition and specifies Shannon entropy divided by log observed richness using the same logarithm base.
Concrete reference values, zero-padding, singleton, empty-community and base-2 examples correspond to retained native test_pielou_e coverage.
Normalization statements apply to the retained public API count-vector domain; empty/singleton exceptions are explicitly stated.
Baseline and two incorrect implementations fail; native reference and alternative implementation pass, including a repeat.
limitations: Formula and expected examples make this a guided source repair, not biological discovery.
Finite native assertions do not prove correctness for all count vectors or arbitrary logarithm bases.
Manual independent review and control construction remain assistance; this is not an autonomous acceptance pipeline.
